name: explainroo
one_liner: Free, open-source explainer videos made by your AI coding agent, with voice, timing and rendering all on your computer.

text.why: Recording a voice, editing and wrangling video tools just for a short explainer is a lot. With explainroo you tell your agent the topic, it writes the script and drawings, and you get an MP4.
text.take: You can start by giving your agent the repository address and a topic.
build: The agent writes two files, script.md and scenes.js; the open Kokoro voice model reads the script, Whisper times each word, and the drawings appear on cue. No account or API key. Example looks include paper, chalk and blueprint.

who.role: Anyone who wants explainer videos without a studio, especially coding-agent users.

start.text: Paste the prompt from the README into your agent with your topic; it clones the repository and follows AGENTS.md.

caveat: Needs a coding agent, and the README says it works best with Claude Code and Opus 5.5 for now. Recently released, with about 300 stars.

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: Five explainroo looks: Paper (pour-over coffee), Clean (a sales pipeline), Chalk (a fridge), Blueprint (an API) and Midnight (a cache).

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
null in the JSON means not observed — never zero. The Markdown writes [unconfirmed] for it.
